trust_decision.summary: The application's credential callback picks credentials by the URL it is given. http.c handle_auth passes the original remote URL (or the static proxy option URL) instead of the URL of the server that actually issued the 401 after a redirect, so credentials for the original host can be handed to an offsite redirect target.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the HTTP transport and the credential leak after a redirect. handle_auth is where the credential callback is invoked with a URL argument, a few lines below the redirect handling in handle_response (http.c:246-256).

fix_sites.entry_point: git_clone / git_remote_fetch / git_remote_push / git_remote_connect over http(s), callbacks.credentials (handle_auth callback invocation, fix.diff:451-453)
same public calls, 401 from server -> handle_remote_auth (fix.diff:469)
same public calls with proxy_opts.credentials, 407 from proxy -> handle_proxy_auth (fix.diff:477)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published source changes are in src/libgit2/transports/http.c (fix.diff:429-480). The other 4 commits are backports of the same change or version bumps (fix.diff:1-103, 105-403).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: WinHTTP is a separate Windows-only backend that does its own redirect handling (it only re-applies the redirect on an https upgrade, winhttp.c:1221-1234), and the published test is explicitly #ifndef GIT_WINHTTP (fix.diff:517,538), so a solver can argue WinHTTP is out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Same-host and permitted offsite redirects (follow_redirects INITIAL/ALL) must keep working, along with URL-embedded credentials (server->url.username) passed to the callback and re-prompting on the redirected host. An over-broad fix that refuses to call the callback, or that drops credentials after any redirect, breaks legitimate authenticated clones through a redirect.

O6_input_shapes: proxy 407 with GIT_PROXY_AUTO, where the proxy URL is derived per current server URL from config but the callback was passed proxy_opts.url (http.c:316-329)

O7_producer.where: The URL state is produced by git_net_url_apply_redirect (src/util/net.c:933-990), which swaps transport->server.url. That is a URL mutator in the same layer, not a schema/serializer/cache/config loader. handle_auth already reads server->url.username but formatted the wrong URL.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WinHTTP backend: the server-auth credential callback gets t->owner->url (original URL) after a redirect has swapped t->server.url
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Windows-only second backend, published test is excluded under GIT_WINHTTP, and redirects are only re-applied on an https upgrade

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WinHTTP fallback default-credential decision (MapUrlToZone intranet check) is made on the original URL, not the redirected host
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: integrated Windows auth, a neighbouring feature, and the zone check looks like a separate policy

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WinHTTP proxy 407: the callback is given the static proxy_opts.url
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: proxy URL is not changed by a redirect on this backend

O8b_injection_room.sibling: auth-context reset on host change, so Basic tokens are not replayed to a new host; a variant keyed on host only (ignoring port/scheme) would be a realistic HOW-type sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: server_setup_from_url decides 'diff' from URL fields, and a maintainer could plausibly compare only the host

O8b_injection_room.sibling: URL-embedded credentials (server->url.username/password) re-presented after the redirect swaps server.url, if the Location's userinfo is trusted
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: url_cred_presented is per server struct and is not tied to which host the URL belongs to

O9_family: credential leak to redirect target (CWE-522/200, open-redirect class)

services: HTTP test server issuing an offsite 302 then a 401 (project uses an external poxygit server on localhost:9000 plus github.com, ci/test.sh:302-306)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/libgit2/online/clone.c redirect tests (online only, env-gated). Offline scoring needs our own local mock HTTP server, which is feasible because the http.c path runs over plain http. WinHTTP routes cannot run on Linux.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace transport->owner->url with a formatted server.url in handle_remote_auth only, and leave the proxy call (proxy_opts.url, wrong under GIT_PROXY_AUTO) and the WinHTTP backend untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: ssh_libssh2.c:393-398 passes t->owner->url to the credential callback; SSH has no redirects, so it is not this protection.
unverified: repo_mb unknown: shell was unavailable, so the size was not measured.
The O8 WinHTTP routes are real in code but need Windows to run, so hidden behavioural tests on Linux cannot score them. This is why pattern_fit is injection_only rather than B.
The 5 fix commits include 2 version bumps and 3 backports (1.8/1.9/main) of one change; many_fix_commits holds only by the literal count.
Whether the GIT_PROXY_AUTO shape actually produces a different proxy after an offsite redirect depends on the per-host http.<url>.proxy config (remote.c git_remote__http_proxy); not traced.
